title: Interaction between attentional systems and episodic memory encoding: the impact of conflict on binding of information
authors: Sperduti, M., Armougum, A., Makowski, D., Blondé, P., & Piolino, P.
summary: What becomes of a memory formed while attention is busy resolving a conflict. The study measures the cost of attentional conflict at encoding on how information is bound together into a single episode.
